evidence: Frozen task/environment/Dockerfile:14-23 copies only instructions/ and assets/, then creates /app with only a committed .gitkeep; it never copies solution/ or tests/. Hidden-file inventory of task/environment contains exactly that Dockerfile, six Markdown notes and assets/seed_data.json. The seed has snippets: [] and an explanatory note (environment/assets/seed_data.json:2-3). The notes specify product behavior and leave routes, schema and layout to the builder (environment/instructions/integration.md:5; policy.md:3); they contain no starter source, partial UI or finished deliverable. An exact search of all 31 frozen judge criterion IDs across the seven copied text files found zero matches, and inspection found no criterion/rubric text. A broken blank-shell app receives no implementation from these inputs; a conforming app can choose its own routes and schema. Source inspection supports this row; no image was built in this independent read-only assignment.
